title: Studio evaluates the browsed app's navigation `visible` predicates with no `current_user.positions` and a `can()` that cannot answer, logging ten "visibility predicate could not be evaluated" warnings per page
body:
Filing gate **① a defect with a named landing site**. Batch-of: 2026-10-25 browser pass on @objectstack/* 18.1.0 (23 cards: hotcrm 10, objectui 10, objectstack 3). Filed by the maintainer's account (`os-steve`) from the HotCRM pass driven in session `session_01AwpXhq2nFKU6J7GmbCEmZu`; ⛔ not a claim. Grade and routing are objectui triage's.

## What is seen (`@objectstack/console` 18.1.0)

Opening `/_console/studio` and any Studio page of the HotCRM package as the dev admin logs, per page load, one warning per HotCRM navigation entry that carries a `visible` predicate (ten in the pass):

```
[ObjectUI] A visibility predicate could not be evaluated - node "app-shell:visible"
  visible: "!(\"sales_rep\" in current_user.positions)"
  Reason: [runtime] No such key: positions
[ObjectUI] A visibility predicate could not be evaluated - node "app-shell:visible"
  visible: "current_user.can(\"crm_lead\", \"read\")"
  Reason: [runtime] can('crm_lead', 'read') cannot b…
```

The same predicates evaluate cleanly inside the HotCRM app (objectui#12700 landed the permissions map there, and the rep's sidebar hides the right entries). Studio's shell evaluates them against a `current_user` without `positions` and without the permissions map, so every evaluation falls to the safe default and logs.

`reach:` the public UI (browser console), measured once; no user-visible breakage. The cost is noise that hides real predicate faults, and a Studio author reading the console learns that their app's navigation is broken when it is not.

## Expected

Studio either does not evaluate the browsed app's `visible` predicates (it is designing, not rendering, the navigation — the Interfaces rail already lists hidden entries), or it evaluates them with the same `current_user` the app shell builds.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` objectui "Studio app shell evaluates navigation visible predicates without current_user positions warning" → 6 hits (#12700, objectstack-ai/objectui#12426, objectstack-ai/objectui#11167, objectstack-ai/objectui#11153, objectstack-ai/objectui#10743, objectstack-ai/objectui#11203), none about Studio's evaluation context. Report: [REPORT.md](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/03c2ad1573fb93cf1318ab50ae22f9ba770c4166/qa/2026-10-25-browser-pass/REPORT.md) §7 S4.
